answer.evidence: The silhouette is a tall cabinet, 15-16 px wide, drawn from the south. Rows 1-4 form a light band at the top. At x=8 it ends in a lighter blue edge line at row 5 (#5e80b2), followed by darker rows 6-7 that act as eave shadow above the screen frame. This is the cabinet pattern of top, edge line and eave, so I count it as a top surface. The call is borderline, since the band also carries small gray details that could be read as a face-on header panel. Below it the screen (rows 8-13) and a lower body (rows 14-16) form the front face. A wider ledge at rows 17-23 has a gray edge at row 17 and a darker front edge at rows 22-23. Its keypad sits on rows 18-21, which reads as a top surface seen from above. The dispenser section (rows 24-31) is a vertical front face. The front face totals about 26 rows (rows 6-31).
